reason: The README describes a DeepSeek Harness plugin that organizes newly generated files into reusable YYYY-MM-DD_description folders through a system-prompt rule, making files and terminal utilities the primary category.

summaries.zh: 通过系统提示规则，将 Agent 新生成的文件自动归档到按日期和描述命名的文件夹中。
summaries.en: Uses a system-prompt rule to organize newly generated agent files into folders named by date and description.

capabilities: Injects a system-prompt rule that directs the agent to place newly generated files in date-and-description folders
Leaves edits to existing files and explicitly user-specified paths unchanged according to the README
